headline: Foreign Investors Return, Both Stocks and Currency Rise; New Taiwan Dollar Surges 1.7 Jiao Intraday, Closes at 32.315 - Industry & Finance
summary: Hopes for a US-Iran agreement pushed US stocks to record highs and lifted Taiwan shares by 1,250 points, reclaiming the quarterly moving average. The New Taiwan dollar surged over 1.7 jiao intraday and closed at 32.315.
why: Taiwan's stock market is heavily weighted toward semiconductor companies, so its moves are closely tied to global risk sentiment and tech demand. The New Taiwan dollar's direction affects foreign investors' returns on local assets.
why_moved: Hopes for a US-Iran agreement lifted US stocks to record highs, and that risk-on sentiment drew foreign investors back into Taiwan's stocks and currency.
